item.title: Hugging Face Ships Quantized MOSS-VL Models That Run on 24GB Consumer GPUs
item.summary: MOSI and the OpenMOSS team released FP8 and NF4 quantized versions of MOSS-VL-Instruct and MOSS-VL-Realtime on Hugging Face, enabling multimodal image, video, and real-time streaming understanding on consumer GPUs with 24GB of VRAM.
